businesses.business: Wholesale vehicle marketplaces and dealer financing

offering_description.value: Operates online wholesale used-vehicle marketplaces where dealers, automakers, finance companies and fleet operators sell vehicles to dealers. It also arranges inspections and transport and provides short-term inventory financing to independent dealers.

primary_products.value: Used vehicles purchased for wholesale resale in certain markets

primary_services.value: Digital wholesale vehicle auctions; dealer inventory financing; vehicle inspections; vehicle transport coordination; title processing

customer_segment.value: B2B: Franchised and independent vehicle dealers, automakers, vehicle finance companies, rental companies and fleet operators

end_markets.value: Used-vehicle wholesale and remarketing; automotive retail; vehicle leasing and fleet management; dealer inventory finance

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Buyer and seller fees on wholesale vehicle transactions; product sales: Wholesale vehicles purchased and resold in certain markets; service fees: Vehicle inspections, transport and title processing; interest or premiums: Interest on short-term dealer inventory loans
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales; service fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Connects dealer and commercial consignors with wholesale vehicle buyers through digital auctions; distributor: Purchases used vehicles from consignors for wholesale resale to dealers in certain markets; service provider: Inspects vehicles, coordinates transport and processes titles for wholesale buyers and sellers; financial intermediary: Provides independent dealers with short-term loans secured by vehicle inventory
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; distributor; service provider; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: Wholesale marketplaces in the United States, Canada and Europe, with dealer financing in the United States and Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Wholesale used-vehicle marketplaces, remarketing services and dealer inventory financing

distribution_channels.value: online: Web and mobile auction marketplaces and dealer financing portals; direct sales: Account teams serving dealers and institutional vehicle consignors; own locations: Canadian vehicle centers handling inspections, storage and pickup

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Motor vehicle auction and dealer licensing, commercial lending rules and vehicle title requirements
